finish.summary:
The bug in the Weaviate Vector Store node was that `populateVectorStore` deleted the collection/tenant **every time** it was called. Since node version 1.1, the insert operation (`handleInsertOperation` in `insertOperation.ts`) calls `populateVectorStore` in a loop for each batch of documents (default batch size 200). This meant the store was cleared before every batch, so only the last batch survived.

**Fix:** Moved the clear-store logic from `populateVectorStore` to the `beforeInsert` hook on the node configuration. The `beforeInsert` hook is designed exactly for one-time setup before batch inserts — it is called only once before all batches (when node version >= 1.1 and there is at least one document to insert). 

**Changes to `VectorStoreWeaviate.node.ts`:**
- Removed the `if (options.clearStore) { ... }` block from `populateVectorStore`
- Added a new `beforeInsert` callback that contains the same clear-store logic (deleting the collection or removing the tenant)

**Changes to `VectorStoreWeaviate.node.test.ts`:**
- Updated the `createVectorStoreNode` mock to also capture the `beforeInsert` property
- Updated the `TestNode` type to include the optional `beforeInsert` method
- Added three new tests under `describe('beforeInsert')`:
  - "should delete the collection when clearStore is true and no tenant"
  - "should delete the tenant when clearStore is true and tenant is set"  
  - "should not clear anything when clearStore is false"
- Updated the two `populateVectorStore` tests that previously tested clear-store behavior to now verify that `populateVectorStore` does NOT call delete/remove (negative tests confirming the delegation)
finish.risks:
- The fix assumes the `beforeInsert` hook is only called for node version >= 1.1 with batch processing (which is correct per the `insertOperation.ts` code). For node version 1, `populateVectorStore` is called per-item without `beforeInsert`, but version 1 didn't have batch processing and the Clear Data feature was introduced in version 1.1, so this is not a concern.
- The test mock for `createVectorStoreNode` does not pass `meta`, `sharedFields`, etc., but that's fine since this test only inspects the individual callbacks that are set on the returned class.
- No risk of breaking other vector store nodes since this change is specific to Weaviate.
finish.tests_run: All 28 tests in `packages/@n8n/nodes-langchain/nodes/vector_store/VectorStoreWeaviate/VectorStoreWeaviate.node.test.ts` pass. Also verified all 10 tests in `packages/@n8n/ai-utilities/src/utils/vector-store/createVectorStoreNode/operations/__tests__/insertOperation.test.ts` pass (confirming the `beforeInsert` hook integration works correctly).
